command.title: Accessible name of the command palette dialog. The palette is opened with Ctrl+K and lists actions and requests.
command.heading: Heading of the list of actions in the palette.
command.sections.request: Heading of the list of saved requests in the palette.
command.commandsPlaceholder: Placeholder of the palette search field.
command.requestsPlaceholder: Placeholder when the palette opens in the "go to request" mode.
command.sentEarlier: Second line of a result that comes from the history.
command.switchEnvironment: Palette entry. {{name}} is the environment. An environment is a named set of variables.
command.settingsKeywords: Extra search words, separated by spaces, that find the settings commands. Not shown. Use words people would type in your language.
command.commands: Each command has a label and a description. Labels that are not in this file reuse the name of the feature from another part of the app.
command.commands.collapseFolders.keyword: Extra search words, separated by spaces. Not shown.
command.commands.copyRequest.description: Copies the saved request so it can be pasted into a folder.
command.results: Accessible label of the list of matching commands in the command palette.
